bulletin.night: The Northern Limit of Monsoon continues to pass through 10°N/60°E, 9°/65°E, 8.5°N/70°E, 8°N/75°E, 7.8°N/78°E, 8°N/80°E, 10°N/80°E, 13°N/87°E, 16°N/90°E, 19°N/93°E and 22°N/97°E.
